items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: But Morris French was supposed to be one of the top trombone players during that time.

ctx.x: Well he's in the Eureka, the trumpet player, and he's the leader of the Eureka band, the brass band.

Well all right then. So they cannot tell me that the musicians didn't read because I begged to differ with them. Because when I went to New Orleans in 21 to visit, I brought some music down there and I did a little playing around there with Red A. Well Red A didn't do any of the French, or Morris French didn't read either. But some of the men, like Zip, some of the men didn't read because I passed out the parts. And they did read. But Red A had a good ear once they played something over. Well once or twice and…
No I don't think so either.
